decisions.reason: The firm gave the minimum quantity lubrication system its own page and has invested in it as part of its coolant and lubrication portfolio, and the gap in website evidence can be put down to temporary causes such as the pandemic slump in machine tools, so management is likely to persist with it.

The hydrocyclone filter fits the firm's core coolant filtration line and was publicly launched on a page of its own, so sunk development costs and the need to justify the launch favour keeping it despite unclear results.
The gravity band filter is a central and low-risk part of the filtration range the firm has announced, so management would attribute any weak sales to the cyclical downturn and keep it on the market.
